name: HS Digital

use.es: Mitad superior del símbolo, wordmark, titulares, botones principales, fondos oscuros.
use.en: Top half of the mark, wordmark, headings, primary buttons, dark backgrounds.

use.es: Mitad inferior del símbolo, iconos, degradados, texto grande (≥ 24 px).
use.en: Bottom half of the mark, icons, gradients, large text (≥ 24 px).

use.es: Enlaces y texto azul pequeño (5,9:1 sobre blanco).
use.en: Links and small blue text (5.9:1 on white).

es.positioning: El grupo digital que reúne marketing, SEO, diseño y desarrollo web para pymes, con una sola persona de contacto.
es.description: HS Digital es el grupo de HS Marketing, HS SEO, HS Design y HS Dev. Cuando tu proyecto necesita más de una especialidad, lo resolvemos dentro de casa con una sola persona de contacto.
es.boilerplate: HS Digital es un grupo de agencias digitales para pymes de España que atiende en Madrid y Bilbao, y en remoto. Reúne HS Marketing (redes sociales y anuncios), HS SEO (posicionamiento en Google), HS Design (diseño web) y HS Dev (desarrollo y mantenimiento web). Cada especialidad tiene su equipo y sus estándares; el cliente tiene un solo interlocutor. Sin permanencia y sin resultados que no podamos demostrar.

pillars.name: Para quién
pillars.title: Pymes y negocios locales
pillars.text: Empresas de Madrid, Bilbao y el resto de España que quieren crecer online sin coordinar cinco proveedores.

pillars.name: El problema
pillars.title: Demasiados proveedores
pillars.text: Uno lleva las redes, otro la web, otro el SEO, y nadie habla con nadie.

pillars.name: La promesa
pillars.title: Un grupo, un interlocutor
pillars.text: Especialistas en cada área, mismos estándares y una sola persona de contacto.

es.socialLine: Marketing, SEO, diseño y desarrollo web para pymes
es.accentUse: Sin acento propio: el grupo usa Navy y Blue. Los cuatro acentos solo aparecen juntos para presentar la familia.
es.motifText: Las dos mitades del símbolo como formas grandes (máscaras, esquinas, fondos) y «el corte»: la línea blanca que atraviesa la H.
rules: Una web propietaria por búsqueda: hsdigital.es lleva marketing digital, Google Ads, branding y la marca HS Digital.
La línea «Parte de HS Digital» se escribe igual en todas las webs hermanas.
Bloque de grupo en el pie: HS Digital, HS Marketing, HS SEO, HS Dev, HS Design.
Nunca resultados, valoraciones ni cifras de clientes inventadas.

subBrands.hs-marketing: Redes sociales, contenido, anuncios y Google Maps para negocios locales.
subBrands.hs-seo: Posicionamiento en Google (y en IA) para pymes, sin humo.
subBrands.hs-design: Diseño web y UX/UI que se entiende a la primera.
subBrands.hs-dev: Desarrollo web, tiendas WooCommerce y mantenimiento WordPress.

tone.why: Tú, frases cortas y palabras normales: el dueño de un negocio tiene que entenderlo a la primera.
Nunca cifras, valoraciones ni resultados inventados. Si algo tarda meses, lo decimos.
Cada área la lleva quien sabe de ella; el grupo lo coordina y da la cara.

doDont.do: Un solo interlocutor para tu web, tus redes y tu SEO.
Cada mes te contamos qué hemos hecho y qué ha cambiado.
Sin permanencia: te quedas porque funciona.

doDont.dont: Sinergias entre nuestras unidades de negocio.

en.positioning: The digital group that brings marketing, SEO, web design and development together for small businesses, with a single point of contact.
taglines: One point of contact for everything.
en.description: HS Digital is the group behind HS Marketing, HS SEO, HS Design and HS Dev. When your project needs more than one speciality, we solve it in-house with a single point of contact.
en.boilerplate: HS Digital is a group of digital agencies for small businesses in Spain, serving clients in Madrid, Bilbao and remotely. It brings together HS Marketing (social media and ads), HS SEO (search rankings), HS Design (web design) and HS Dev (web development and maintenance). Each speciality has its own team and standards; the client has one point of contact. No lock-in contracts and no results we can't prove.

pillars.name: Who it's for
pillars.title: Small and local businesses
pillars.text: Companies in Madrid, Bilbao and across Spain that want to grow online without juggling five suppliers.

pillars.name: The problem
pillars.title: Too many suppliers
pillars.text: One does social, another the website, another SEO, and nobody talks to anybody.

pillars.name: The promise
pillars.title: One group, one contact
pillars.text: Specialists in every area, the same standards and one point of contact.

en.socialLine: Marketing, SEO, web design and development for small businesses
en.accentUse: No accent of its own: the group uses Navy and Blue. The four accents only appear together to present the family.
en.motifText: The two halves of the mark as large shapes (masks, corners, backgrounds) and "the cut": the white line through the H.
rules: One owner site per search: hsdigital.es owns digital marketing, Google Ads, branding and the HS Digital brand.
The line "Part of HS Digital" is worded the same on every sister site.
Group block in the footer: HS Digital, HS Marketing, HS SEO, HS Dev, HS Design.
Never invented results, ratings or client numbers.
groupBenefits: One point of contact for everything

subBrands.hs-marketing: Social media, content, ads and Google Maps for local businesses.
subBrands.hs-seo: Ranking on Google (and in AI answers) for small businesses, without the hype.
subBrands.hs-design: Web and UX/UI design that makes sense at first glance.
subBrands.hs-dev: Web development, WooCommerce shops and WordPress maintenance.

tone.why: Informal you, short sentences and plain words: a business owner must get it first time.
Never invented figures, ratings or results. If something takes months, we say so.
Each area is run by people who know it; the group coordinates and is accountable.

doDont.do: One point of contact for your website, social media and SEO.
Every month we tell you what we did and what changed.
No lock-in: you stay because it works.

openQuestions: CMYK and Pantone values are screen-to-print estimates: ask the printer for a colour proof.
Legal name: kit uses "HS Digital Solutions LTD" as confirmed by the owner (2026-11-13); the site settings note the UK Ltd was reverted. Check before printing legal documents.
Offices: the sites only say «Atendemos en Madrid y Bilbao»; the kit shows the two addresses as confirmed by the owner.
The site lockup SVGs (in source/) are not set in Bricolage Grotesque; the kit redraws every lockup in Bricolage. Update the sites to the kit logos.
Tone, do/don't and word lists were written for this kit (the group site has none yet): review them.
